title: PRCC-TFE3 Dual-Fusion FISH Assay for Identifying Renal Cell Carcinoma
author: Lei Xiong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jdfci3n
materials: FISH experimental procedure:After deparaffinization and washing, three-micrometer-thick paraffin-embedded sections were rehydrated in 100%, 85%, and 70% ethanol in turn for 3 minutes and digested with 10μL pepsin (4 mg/mL, 0.02M HCl; Sigma-Aldrich, Beijing, China) at 37℃ for 3 to 5 minutes, followed by subsequent dehydration. Then, the probe mixture was applied, and the slides were denatured at 85℃ for 5 minutes and target DNA simultaneously, followed by hybridization overnight at 37℃. The slides were immersed in 2×SSC for 10 minutes and in 0.1% NP-40/2×SSC for 5 minutes at 37℃. The nuclei were counterstained with 4, 6-diamidino-2-phenylindole (DAPI). After hybridization, all slides were maintained at 4℃ in the dark.

steps.title: Design PRCC-TFE3 Dual-Fusion FISH Probe
steps.instruction: Select and label BAC clones to cover the TFE3 and PRCC genes using the UCSC Genome Browser.

substeps.instruction: Select 7 BAC clones (CTD-2311N12, RP11-416B14, CTD-2522M13, CTD-2516D6, CTD-2312C1, CTD-2248C21, and RP11-959H17) covering the TFE3 gene on the short arm of the X chromosome and label them with fluorescein-12-dUTP (green).
Select 4 BAC clones (CTD-2534H6, RP11-1047J23, RP11-730I22, and CTD-2547N15) covering the PRCC gene on the long arm of chromosome 1 and label them with tetramethylrhodamine-5-dUTP (red).

steps.title: Determine Positive Result Cutoff
steps.instruction: Establish the fusion-signal percentage cutoff using normal renal tissues from 20 non-PRCC-TFE3 renal cell carcinoma cases.

substeps.instruction: Observe signals of 50 nuclei per case and calculate the percentage of cells with fusion signals.
Calculate the mean and standard deviation of these percentages.
Set the cutoff as the sum of the mean and three times the standard deviation (determined to be >2% of tumor nuclei for a positive result).

steps.title: Evaluate FISH Results
steps.instruction: Examine slides using an Olympus BX51TRF fluorescence microscope with DAPI, FITC, and TexasRed filters and Imstar FISH analysis software.

substeps.instruction: Examine a minimum of 100 nonoverlapping tumor cell nuclei per case.
Identify negative results as split green and red signals (intact Xp11 and 1q21).
Identify positive results as a dual fusion signal pattern (two fusion signals), where a fusion signal is defined as a yellow or closely approximated green-red signal.
